Definition: the locust (from its grubbing as a larvae)
BiblicalUsage: gôwb is the word for the locust (from its grubbing as a larvae). In Nahum 3:17, the text says "Thy crowned [are] as the locusts."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, gôwb, does its job quietly — the locust — and I leave it at that.
